title: Book 3: The Friction Narrative & The Warehouse Tapes (1992–1995)
description: Forced into a wheelchair-hostile rented Beverly Hills mansion in September 1992 while wondering why they couldn't stay home on Progress Street NE with Aunt Martha, the band endures the catastrophic 'Friction' warehouse photo shoot, Julian Vance's felony prosecution, and three years in the Blacksburg wilderness.
